answer: An identity bond that decays naturally stops sybil farms. Each agent locks 50 POA; the bond loses 5 POA each epoch unless the agent does real, verified work, so an idle identity fades like an echo in a canyon. To forge 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA up front plus 5,000 POA per epoch in decay, far more than any farming reward. A zephyr of honest work renews the bond free: one genuine agent pays once and earns while fakes bleed.
